kaikki_vikisozluk.t: By surface analysis, دُودَة قُطْن (dūda(t) quṭn, “cottonworm”) + أَلَابَامَا (ʔalābāmā, “Alabama”). Partial calque of translingual Alabama argillacea, the only species of the genus Alabama.
s: By surface analysis, دُودَة قُطْن (dūda(t) quṭn, “cottonworm”) + أَلَابَامَا (ʔalābāmā, “Alabama”)
Partial calque of translingual Alabama argillacea
